title: Add config catalog

context.summary: Introduce a central typed configuration catalog as the source of runtime and installer env metadata.
context.background: Mindory currently loads runtime configuration from scattered MINDORY_* defaults in code, .env.example and Compose. The installer plan requires one catalog for defaults, prompts, validation, secret flags and support status.

in: Add a typed config catalog for current runtime env variables and first installer env variables.
Move config loader defaults to the catalog instead of inline literals.
Generate or validate .env.example from the catalog.
Add validation that MINDORY_* variables in config, Compose and scripts are represented in the catalog.
Document the catalog as the required source for future installer/config work.
out: Implementing the installer wizard or rollback engine.

acceptance_criteria: @mindory/config exposes a typed catalog with env name, default, type, prompt metadata, secret flag, support status and installer visibility.
loadMindoryConfig reads defaults from the catalog instead of duplicating default literals.
.env.example is generated from or validated against the catalog.
A validator fails when a MINDORY_* env variable used by runtime/Compose/scripts is missing from the catalog.
Docs explain that new configuration must be added through the catalog.
No database schema changes are included.

manual_checks: Confirm .env.example matches the generated catalog output.

risks: Catalog validation must not block existing planned env names before TASK-53 renames the model runtime namespace.
Installer-only settings should be cataloged without changing runtime behavior beyond adding an install config section.
definition_of_done: Task status is changed to accepted or done.
Branch is committed and merged back into master.
